title: Whispering Whelk Waltzer
statement: A pearly, spiral-shelled sea snail that glides in slow, looping figure-eights through a moonlit tank of drifting kelp and softly glowing sea-glass, humming faint bubbles that pop in time with its steps. Whenever it passes a rock it pauses, tips its shell like a hat, and leaves a trail of shimmering lavender light behind it.
